name: Killer
description: Defeat every enemy to clear. Pays x1.25.
_help: minimum: every stage gets at least this many enemies (extras are added on safe ground when the level pieces bring too few). An objective twist: it changes how you win, not how you move. objective "kill": in the platformer the exit stays locked until every enemy is stomped; in the shmup an enemy that escapes off the screen costs a life. Not on the brawler, where beating every enemy is already the rule.
